definition_en: red marks on the skin of the face
example: Many young people get red acne marks on their faces.

definition_en: a person who acts in a film, play or show
example: The clever actor played a brave detective in the film.

definition_en: to let someone do something
example: Teachers do not allow phones during the school film show.

definition_en: to think that something is good and right
example: The director smiled to approve the new scene in the film.

definition_en: a prize given to someone for doing something very well
example: The exciting adventure film won an award at the festival.

definition_en: a popular book that very many people buy
example: Her new mystery story is a bestseller in one week.

definition_en: feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting
example: Tom was bored because the film was too long.

definition_en: important news that has just happened
example: The programme has breaking news about the festival.

definition_en: a time when you can do something you want to do
example: Pupils had a chance to meet famous stars at the cinema.

definition_en: a person or animal in a book, film or play
example: James is a famous character in mystery books.

definition_en: someone who makes or invents something new
example: The creator of the story made all the funny heroes.

definition_en: a person who writes their opinion about films or books
example: The film critic wrote a very good review in the paper.

definition_en: not straight or even in shape
example: The bad man in the cartoon had a crooked nose.

definition_en: to grow or become bigger and more complete
example: Good writers develop the story so people want to read more.

definition_en: to tell actors in a film or play what to do
example: A famous person came to our town to direct a film.

definition_en: a picture made with a pen or pencil
example: The book has a bright drawing on every page.

definition_en: very bad and dangerous to other people
example: In the story, the young spy stops an evil man.

definition_en: a test done to learn something new
example: The clever scientist did an experiment in the lab.

definition_en: special skill and knowledge in something
example: She used her expertise to make digital art for the film.

definition_en: not allowed by a rule or law
example: Entering the film set without a pass is forbidden.

definition_en: to get something good or useful
example: Young pupils gain useful skills working at the film show.

definition_en: a particular kind or type of film, book or music
example: Comedy is my favourite film genre because it makes me laugh.

definition_en: to become ready for people to buy in shops
example: The new book will hit the shelves next week.

definition_en: a picture in a book or magazine
example: Each story has a picture with bright colours.

definition_en: dirty or untidy; not clean
example: The artist room was messy with paper and paints.

definition_en: an important job that someone is sent to do
example: The secret agent had a dangerous mission to save the city.

definition_en: a long tool used with water to clean floors
example: Use a clean mop to wash the cinema floor.

definition_en: making you feel strong feelings of love or care
example: The end of the story was very moving and sweet.

definition_en: very bad, mean or not nice
example: The bad man had a nasty voice in the story.

definition_en: a book that tells a long story about people who are not real
example: I read an exciting novel about a family on an island.

definition_en: to let someone do something by a rule
example: Teachers permit only pupils into the quiet film room.

definition_en: the things that happen in a story or film
example: The film had an exciting plot with lots of surprises.

definition_en: to ask for something politely
example: Pupils can request their favourite song at the school party.

definition_en: the words and directions written for a film
example: The writer finished the screenplay for the new adventure film.

definition_en: looking untidy and dirty in clothes or hair
example: The funny detective had a scruffy brown jacket.

definition_en: the place and time where a story happens
example: The setting of the story is an old mountain castle.

definition_en: a little bit; not very much
example: The evening film ticket was slightly cheaper for students.

definition_en: having no tickets left to sell
example: All tickets for the afternoon cinema show were sold out.

definition_en: clever, modern and well made
example: The secret agent used a sophisticated tiny camera.

definition_en: a person who works secretly to find out information about others
example: The secret spy had to find the lost plans.

definition_en: to turn a light or machine on or off
example: Please switch off the television before you go to bed.

definition_en: the name of a book, film or song
example: The title of the funny book is 'The Flying Cat'.

definition_en: a person who watches a film or television programme
example: Every viewer smiled when the film had a happy end.
